input.comment: [Playbook] Our playbook does not accept exclusivity binding the Company; at most we can live with a defined product category for twelve months that ends automatically if HDI misses its service levels or delivery dates. We have therefore limited Section 6.1 to the initial one-year term and added an automatic performance-based release, leaving HDI's reciprocal exclusivity in Section 6.3 untouched.
input.summary: Limit Company exclusivity to 12 months and add automatic exit on HDI performance failure.
